finding: The payment charge operation is retried without an idempotency mechanism, so a transient failure can cause the external charge to be executed more than once.
evidence: RetryPolicy.cs invokes gateway.ChargeAsync(cardToken, amount) again, while the supplied context states that no idempotency key is present.
suggested_fix: Use an idempotency key or an equivalent provider-supported deduplication mechanism for each logical payment operation.
